items.description:
Huang Mei Sushi and Chinese Food is a restaurant in Mowbray, Cape Town, serving Chinese dishes and sushi. Guests can eat in or order for delivery or collection through the online menu, and the business says it serves fresh, high-quality dishes made with care.

Reviewers praise the freshness and value, and mention the salmon roses, chop suey and large mixed platters, which they say are made immediately even when the restaurant is busy. Fortune cookies are sold at R5 each.

The restaurant is at 4 Caledonian Road in Mowbray, and it suits families and office workers in the area who want sushi and Chinese food to eat in or collect.

Il Leone Mastrantonio is a convivial Italian restaurant in Green Point, serving traditional and modern Italian dishes. It is often busy with loyal locals and visitors from nearby hotels, and its menu centres on well-prepared Italian classics with a flavour punch.

The menu has options for vegetarians, pescatarians and meat-eaters alike. Guests can have a drink at the bar before being seated, and the downstairs tables are the ones to ask for, so the guide advises booking well in advance.

The restaurant is at 22 Cobern Street in Green Point, and it suits diners who enjoy people-watching and a lively evening out with friends.

Indigo Scuba is a scuba diving operator in Gordon's Bay that runs boat dives, guided dives and fun dives to the reefs and dive sites along the coast. Its internationally recognised courses include SSI and RAID programmes, from the SSI Open Water Diver course, which teaches divers to dive safely down to 18 metres, to the advanced courses.

Other services include underwater photography courses, daily swimming lessons in an indoor heated pool, equipment rental and dive charters. The business also lists the Gordon's Bay dive sites and offers DAN membership.

The operator is based in Gordon's Bay, and it suits beginners who want to learn to dive as well as experienced divers who want guided trips to local reefs.

Infusion on Long is a restaurant, bar and lounge at 57 Long Street in Cape Town's CBD. The menu ranges from quick-service lunches to relaxed, experiential dinners with a wide variety of dishes, and the business says its cuisine is designed to suit every palate.

The dining room is elegantly set with an industrial modern theme, handcrafted flooring and bespoke furniture finishes. The venue hosts private functions and special occasions, and its social atmosphere includes live music, weekly promotions and the popular charcoal cuisine.

The restaurant is kids and pet friendly, and it suits Capetonians and visitors who want a lively evening out on Long Street or a venue for an event.

items.description:
Intrinsic Hair and Beauty is a hair salon in Plumstead, Cape Town, offering cuts, colour and styling alongside beauty treatments. Services include ladies cuts, a ten-minute express colour, colour highlights, keratin and straightening treatments, a nano blowout and head spa rituals.

The salon also offers facials, manicures, pedicures, nail services, facial and body waxing, and treatments for weddings and special occasions, with separate menus for pensioners and children. Reviewers on Fresha, where the salon is rated 4.9 from more than 1,900 reviews, praise the head massage at the wash station and the blow-dries.

It suits clients who want a broad menu of hair and beauty services, from a quick cut to a full colour or spa-style treatment.

items.description:
Krystal Restaurant is a modern, refined restaurant on the waterfront of the Harbour Island peninsula in Gordon's Bay. It offers a departure from pub-style food, with fine dining and views over False Bay and the Hottentots Holland Mountains.

The menu includes gourmet French sandwiches on homemade bread, fresh salads, seafood dishes, a regularly updated Chef's Choice and elegant desserts. The modern art display and simple décor let the views take centre stage.

In summer the outdoor viewing deck is a good spot for a cocktail as the sun sets over the harbour. The restaurant is part of the Krystal Beach Hotel, and it suits couples and guests who want a classic sea-front dinner in Gordon's Bay.

Little Lambs Christian Daycare is a Christian early childhood centre in Imizamo Yethu, Hout Bay, for children aged one to six. It is a registered South African NPO and public benefit organisation, and it was founded in 1999.

The centre provides early childhood education, daily meals and spiritual care, and it teaches Christian values and basic life skills to prepare children for formal schooling. Its aim is to offer accessible and affordable childcare for families in the area, giving each child an early head start.

The organisation employs members of the local community as educators and helps them build careers in early childhood development. It suits families in Imizamo Yethu and nearby Hout Bay who want a safe, nurturing start for their young children.

items.description:
O on Kloof Boutique Hotel is a five-star boutique hotel in Bantry Bay on the Atlantic Seaboard, with ten rooms and suites for up to 20 guests and a pool. The listing describes it as an exclusive oasis of tranquillity with ocean views and a view of Lion's Head.

Rooms are equipped with mini bars, tea and coffee making facilities, air conditioning, heaters and electronic safes. The hotel is in the wind-free part of Bantry Bay, and it describes its hospitality as the reason many guests return.

Bookings can be made through the hotel's contact details or the SA-Venues site, which lists payment by credit card, instant EFT and bank transfer. It suits guests who want a quiet, ocean-view stay on the Atlantic Seaboard.

Oh So Boho is a bohemian boutique in Kalk Bay, offering handmade fashion, sterling silver jewellery and colourful homeware. The business says it was established in Cape Town more than 30 years ago, when it began by sourcing artisan pieces from India, Nepal, Thailand and Morocco.

Today it supports international craftsmanship and South African designers, and it stocks locally made clothing, jewellery, natural beauty products, home décor and artisanal shoes. Its block print collection is one of its cornerstones, with each piece made by artists in small-scale production.

The boutique is at 96 to 98 Main Road, and the homeware shop Casa Boho is at 108 Main Road. It suits shoppers who want slow, intentional fashion and handmade pieces with a travel-inspired feel.

OHMM Face and Beauty is a beauty studio in the Dean Street Arcade in Newlands, Cape Town. Its treatments include skincare, therapeutic massage, nail treatments, waxing, IPL laser, eyelash extensions, spray tanning, permanent make-up and aesthetics.

The business describes its therapists as professional and experienced, and clients can book treatments by phone, WhatsApp or email. It highlights the arcade's undercover parking and boutique shopping as part of the visit.

The studio is in Shop 2B on the corner of Dean Street and Main Street in the heart of Newlands Village. It suits clients who want a range of face and body treatments in one location.

items.description:
Rosetta Roastery is an award-winning specialty coffee roaster in Cape Town. It sources speciality-grade, single-origin coffees from South and Central America, Africa and Asia, and micro-roasts each one to bring out its character.

The roastery tests more than 150 coffees each year and releases small batches of single-origin coffee. Customers can order coffee and equipment online, take out subscriptions, buy drip sachets and gift vouchers, and follow brew guides. Wholesale orders are also available.

The business says its coffee is best enjoyed fresh, at its cafés or at home, and it suits home brewers and coffee lovers who want freshly roasted single-origin beans.

Rustenburg Pharmacy is a community pharmacy at 48 Beach Road in Muizenberg, a stone's throw from Surfer's Corner Beach. It has served Muizenberg, Marina da Gama, Lakeside, St James and Kalk Bay for 36 years, and the team says it has become an information centre for many local questions.

The pharmacy serves a varied customer base, from long-time loyal customers and the local surfing community to holidaymakers, international tourists, students and residents of nearby retirement homes. It is part of the Alpha Pharmacies group, whose website lists clinic appointments and AlphaDoc services.

It suits families, surfers and holidaymakers in Muizenberg and the nearby suburbs who want everyday pharmacy advice close to home.

items.description:
Swan Cafe is a French crêperie and café in Zonnebloem, Cape Town, which describes itself as the city's first authentic Parisian crêperie. It serves sweet crêpes, savoury gluten-free buckwheat galettes, salads and all-day brunch.

The café has an exclusive tea range with names such as French Kiss and Paris Je T'aime, along with artisanal coffee. The interior has a South Bank chic look, and the café says it has been open since May 2018 and has been listed in Inside Guide's best breakfast spots.

The venue can also be hired for special occasions and photo shoots, and it suits breakfast fans, tea lovers and anyone who wants a French-style meal in the city.

items.description:
The Welgemoed Guesthouse is an upmarket guesthouse in the Welgemoed neighbourhood of Bellville, with views of the Bellville golf course and the Hottentots Holland mountains. It has ten luxury rooms, including thatch rooms on the upper level with views of the pool area and deluxe rooms on the ground floor with doors that open onto the pool.

The guesthouse offers fine traditional cuisine, a relaxed setting, ample secure parking and transfers to and from Cape Town International Airport. It says it was developed over about ten years, and that its professional, well-trained team aims to make every stay care-free and homely.

It suits travellers who want a quiet, homely guesthouse with a pool, secure parking and airport transfers.

items.description:
Atlas Trading Company is a spice store at 104 Wale Street in Bo-Kaap, Cape Town, established in 1946. The family-owned shop sells spices, rice and rare global ingredients, and says it is Cape Town's oldest spice store.

The store specialises in Cape Malay, Indian and Thai cuisines and offers more than 150 spice blends and flavours, along with 30 unique creations that are exclusive to Atlas. Its range covers pure, natural spices that it says are carefully sourced from around the world.

The shop publishes recipes on its website and sells its products online, and it suits home cooks and professional chefs who want authentic blends for curries and fusion dishes.

items.description:
Camps Bay Haute Coiffure is a hair salon on The Promenade in Camps Bay, Cape Town. It describes itself as award-winning and was voted Best Hairdresser in KFM's Best of the Cape Awards 2025, and its stylists work with both Caucasian and ethnic hair.

The salon offers Japanese head spa treatments, Hydro Luxe facials, Japanese silk treatments, and hair colouring and styling including balayage, highlights and perms. It also offers a nine-minute permanent colour service, strengthening treatments and Korean glass-glow skin treatments.

Education and consultation are central to its approach, and walk-ins are welcome. It suits clients who want luxury hair and skin treatments in Camps Bay.

Cape Biologix is a plant-based biotechnology manufacturer in Ndabeni, Cape Town, and a subsidiary of Cape Bio Pharms. It makes plant-made recombinant proteins, including antibodies and antigens for research and diagnostic use, and it was started in 2020 to contribute to global biosecurity.

Its transient plant-based expression platform, which the company calls PtX, turns plants into what it describes as mini bioreactors. The company says the platform is faster, more flexible, more scalable and more sustainable than traditional expression systems, and it uses it to help improve the health and well-being of people and animals.

The company holds an ISO 13485 certificate, and it offers a first free sample of its antibodies and antigens. It suits laboratories and research teams that need plant-made proteins.
